issues.description: The solution's Person class declares the firstName field as an int while the template (and the test code) use String for firstName and the getter/setter signatures expect String. This is an inner- and cross-artifact attribute type mismatch: the field type in the solution will not compile with the String-based getters/setters and will break tests that set a String name. Students will be confused which type to use and the provided solution code is structurally inconsistent with the template and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the type of the firstName field consistent across artifacts. Change the solution's Person.firstName declaration to String (matching the template and tests) or, alternatively, update the getters/setters and all tests to use int consistently. The preferred fix is to restore private String firstName in src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java in the solution repository so it matches the template and test expectations.
